thread:
orbis_engineer: Hi Redwood — we're finishing a bespoke SIG/CAIQ and hit two issues: 1) our engineer can't export audit logs for keys in KMS (keystore export endpoint intermittently 401s), 2) we need a sanitized sample log for the questionnaire. Due date in 48h, can you help?

maria_cs: thanks @orbis_engineer — looping SRE + security. Can you paste a minimal curl and the full response body + any request-id from the failing call?

orbis_engineer: minimal repro: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.cust.orbis.xxx" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keystore/export -d '{"key_id":"kp-1234"}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{ "error": "unauthorized", "code": "auth_failure" }
no x-request-id in headers, only Date and Server. Happens ~1/20 calls.

oliver_sre: thanks. two quick asks: can you grab the failing request's "x-redwood-request-id" (if present) and the time window when it happened? also confirm client clock is NTP-synced (we've seen signed tokens reject when skew >5m).

orbis_engineer: happened ~2024-11-24T15:12:20Z — client servers are using cloud provider NTP, but i'll double-check skew. no request-id was returned to client; i'll check proxy logs.

oliver_sre: if you can reproduce capture full tcp/https headers. meanwhile try this fallback: add header `X-Feature-Preview: keystore-export-v2` and POST to `/v1/keystore/export-preview` — that route uses an alternate auth path and should succeed for read-only exports. small chance it bypasses the intermittent 401.

orbis_engineer: ok trying now... got 200 with export-preview, thanks. can we use that for the evidence? file is ~12MB.

emily_security: tagging for SIG evidence: we need a sanitized audit log sample showing key export events, key id, timestamp, and principal, plus a copy of the HSM attestation (if the key is HSM-backed). If you supply the export-preview output we can redact principals and IPs. Also we need a short writeup of retention policies + last rotation date.

orbis_engineer: can sanitize and send. one ask: due date is in 48h — can you approve a 72h extension if we need to remove PII from logs?

maria_cs: I can request extension from the reviewer. copying internal timeline. @emily_security can you confirm 72h is fine?

emily_security: yes 72h OK for review cycles. please ensure exported log sample includes:
- event.type = "keystore.export"
- event.outcome = "success"/"failure"
- key_id (we can pseudonymize)
- iso8601 timestamp
We need an HSM attestation file or confirmation it's not HSM-backed.

deploy-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-2024-4578 — Assigned to SRE + Security.

orbis_engineer: will produce sanitized sample and rotation statement. quick Q: any required format for the log snippet? csv/json?

emily_security: JSON preferred, one event per line. keep <=50 events for questionnaire evidence. remove full request/response bodies.

orbis_engineer: copy. sending sample in 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_cs: I'll follow up with reviewer on the extension and update ticket. if you still see 401s after clock check, @oliver_sre can escalate to infra for temporary bypass.

oliver_sre: also added a small server-side check we can enable for your org to log the missing request-id headers for deeper tracing. will do if 401s persist.

orbis_engineer: updated — we fixed NTP skew on one host and 401s dropped. export-preview path is fine for evidence. will upload sanitized sample to the ticket.

emily_security: great, thanks. once we have sample + attestation i'll prepare SIG answers and patch the bespoke form.

maria_cs: noted, closing loop after ticket update.

orbis_engineer: thanks everyone, very smooth.
